'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Reid Smith LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Reid E. Smith
* '''Deck name:''' Loathing
* '''Username:''' 3MW0J8(?)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
